fact: The World Bank's June 2026 project paper says that, with about 4.8 million people enrolled, the Togo e-ID system has been integrated with the social registry (RSPM) and the digital public services portal.
title: Project Paper on a proposed additional credit to the Republic of Benin and to the Republic of Togo for the West Africa Unique Identification for Regional Integration and Inclusion - Phase 2 (P169594)
